boxes.title: Veto: added detail
items: Money Bill: President **usually assents**, as it comes with his ==prior recommendation==
**Financial Bills (I) and (II)** can be returned for reconsideration
Pocket veto = neither assents, rejects nor returns

boxes.title: Ordinance: added detail
items: Not issued when the single House of a **unicameral** State is in session
Not an executive or administrative function
Scope ==co-extensive with Parliament's power==; may modify Central or State laws within competence
Subject to the **same limitations** as an Act

boxes.title: Review, debate, AP
items: Re-promulgation without ratification = ==**subversion of the Constitution**==
IYB 2026 p.**699** misprint on 38th Amdt: read "would **not** be called in question"
Criticism: frequent ordinances **bypass parliamentary deliberation**; executive overreach
